sn32.55:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn32.55:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenekadā abbhaṃ hotīti.
sn32.55:1.6: “yannūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti.” tesaṃ taṃ ceto paṇidhimanvāya abbhaṃ hoti.
sn32.55:1.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenekadā abbhaṃ hotīti.
